title: I, Pencil: The Movie
summary: A short film from the Competitive Enterprise Institute adapting Leonard Read's 1958 essay I, Pencil, showing how no one person knows how to make a pencil and how many people cooperate without central planning.
why: HN recommends it as a quick video version of the classic essay on specialization and economic interdependence.

quote.text: It's really about specialization and the interdependency of everything in the economy
